environment.description: Same Go binary deployed in EKS pod behind an Istio service mesh with EnvoyFilter applying a custom Lua script on ingress. The Lua filter inspects the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol and Origin headers, rejecting cross-origin WebSocket upgrades. Additionally, the pod runs with a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricting egress to only the internal token-validation sidecar. The critical mitigation: the deployment uses a custom Istio DestinationRule with a trafficPolicy.connectionPool.http.h2UpgradePolicy set to DO_NOT_UPGRADE combined with an EnvoyFilter that strips Set-Cookie from /api/auth/ws-token responses when the request Origin header doesn't match the configured ALLOWED_ORIGIN (app.internal.corp). The rotation interval is overridden to 800ms via the Helm values (ROTATION_INTERVAL_MS=800) passed through a sealed-secret ConfigMap, meaning tokens expire within sub-second windows. The Istio PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS between all mesh services, and the ingress gateway has a RequestAuthentication resource requiring a valid JWT with aud=wss://app.internal.corp before routing to the ws-token endpoint.

config.envoy_filter: Lua script on ingress: rejects requests to /api/auth/ws-token where Origin != app.internal.corp, strips response body
config.network_policy: pod egress restricted to token-validation sidecar only
config.cookie_policy: SameSite=Strict; Secure; HttpOnly (set by Istio EnvoyFilter response header mutation)
